Definition: to be (causatively, make) right (in a moral or forensic sense)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be just, be righteous; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to have a just cause, be in the right; 1a2) to be justified; 1a3) to be just (of God); 1a4) to be just, be righteous (in conduct and character); 1b) (Niphal) to be put or made right, be justified; 1c) (Piel) justify, make to appear righteous, make someone righteous; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to do or bring justice (in administering law); 1d2) to declare righteous, justify; 1d3) to justify, vindicate the cause of, save; 1d4) to make righteous, turn to righteousness; 1e) (Hithpael) to justify oneself
